summary: Trinity Biotech filed a Form 6-K on August 14, 2026, disclosing amendments to its credit agreement with Perceptive Credit Holdings III, providing $7.0 million of additional investment ($2.5 million new debt and $4.5 million capitalized interest). It also announced regaining compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule. These are routine financing and compliance updates, not a special-situation event. The filing does not involve a merger, tender, spin-off, or activist campaign. The registrant is the issuer of the report. No special-situation category applies. Watch for continued financing from Perceptive and stock price stability.
